# ReadyDPDP

> India's DPDP Act 2023 readiness and compliance advisory practice. Powered by truConsent.

ReadyDPDP ("Get DPDP Ready.") is India's DPDP Act 2023 readiness and compliance advisory practice. We run DPDP Gap Assessments, provide fractional DPO-as-a-Service, design consent architecture, and build the structured DPDR (Digital Personal Data Register) and CDJR (Customer Data Journey Registry) that underpin a defensible DPDPA compliance programme.

## Services
- [All Services](https://www.readydpdp.com/services/): 15 specialist DPDP Act 2023 compliance services, from Gap Assessment to Incident Response Retainer.
- [DPDP Gap Assessment](https://www.readydpdp.com/services/dpdp-gap-assessment/): Our foundational diagnostic engagement, with a full [deep-dive section](https://www.readydpdp.com/gap-assessment/) on methodology, scope, pricing and deliverables.

## DPDP Readiness Levels
- [Readiness Levels overview](https://www.readydpdp.com/readiness/): A six-level maturity model (Unaware → Optimised) for benchmarking DPDPA compliance posture.

## Frameworks
- [DPDR — Digital Personal Data Register](https://www.readydpdp.com/frameworks/dpdr/): The field-level personal data inventory methodology.
- [CDJR — Customer Data Journey Registry](https://www.readydpdp.com/frameworks/cdjr/): The consent collection point mapping methodology.
